liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Eleven** (2 reviews): The performance of The Eleven cooks in a way the reviewer has not heard before; The reviewer considers this one of their favorite versions of The Eleven yet [14][17]
- **Death Don't Have No Mercy** (1 review): Jerry’s vocals on this track are rare and he really goes after it [14]
- **Jam** (1 review): The jam following the drums is sufficient reason to download the recording [13]

## The recordings

- **gd68-10-12.sbd.eD.10909.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 12 songs; 79 min; rated 4.88/5 by 81 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as raw, fluid, heavy, and tribal in its overall character; The audio is characterized as crystal clean, revealing the blazing glory within the music; Clarity of scratching, likely on a wood block, is trance-inducing during Jerry's lyrics [7][8][9][17][18]
- **gd1968-10-12.139745.sbd.miller.Glassberg.flac1644**: soundboard; 10 songs; 91 min; rated 5/5 by 7 [4]
- **gd1968-10-12.sbd.miller.86759.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 79 min; rated 4.79/5 by 48 [2]
- **gd1968-10-12.sbd.gans.miller.owen.9385.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 79 min; rated 4.83/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Audience members made stunned groans between furious volleys of lightning during the performance [8]
- Jimi Hendrix showed up at the Avalon seeking a chance to jam with the Dead [10]
- Jerry told the wild crowd to cool it, saying they would play until they dropped [11]
- The reviewer considers this their all-time favorite version of the song [11]
- The reviewer rates this as the best 1968 show they have heard to date [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd68-10-12.sbd.eD.10909.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Gans and Frisco; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: The source was originally a mislabeled cassette tape from the era of physical trading [9]
- **gd1968-10-12.139745.sbd.miller.Glassberg.flac1644**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SHNID #115593 > Adobe Audition 3.0 > Flac16 [4]. Also: Lee Michaels, Linn County, and Mance Lipscomb are listed as other artists on the source [4]
- **gd1968-10-12.sbd.miller.86759.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (48k) [2]
- **gd1968-10-12.sbd.gans.miller.owen.9385.shnf**: transferred by David Gans; source: MSR> DAT> Sonic Solutions> CD [3]
